name: expandable
title: Expandable
description: A compact card that expands on click to reveal a list of status checks, with a chevron that flips and a Show more or Show less link at the bottom.
use: A small summary card hides a short list of details that only some users need to open.
avoid: It reflows layout when opened and has a fixed collapsed width, so it is awkward inside tight grids.
a11y: The trigger works from the keyboard but never exposes aria-expanded, and both triggers share the same Toggle expand label. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card holds a small zap icon, the title Quick Actions, a grey subtitle and a downward chevron, with one line of copy and a Show more link. Expanded, the same card is taller and wider with three dot-marked status rows.
behaves: Clicking the chevron or the Show more link springs the card to its larger size and slides the status rows up into view; clicking again collapses it back.
customise: Collapsed and expanded sizes, hover-to-expand, delays and animation presets are props or subcomponent options; card copy is passed as children.
weight: light: One card and a few status rows animated with springs, only on toggle.
